name: Almond Croissant
description: Double baked buttery croissant pieces with toasted almonds are folded into a light almond ice cream base. The result is a flakey, nutty, buttery, sweet toasted treat!

name: Almond Croissant Sammie
description: For a limited time only, this crowd-favourite flavour is back as a sammie! Fluffy almond cake is topped with our delectable almond croissant ice cream – double baked buttery croissant pieces with toasted almonds folded into a light almond base. A layer of warm caramel seals this sammie together with a croissant crumble topping for a delightful crunch!

name: Baklava
description: Buttery layers of phyllo pastry and clusters of spiced nuts are generously scattered through a light, honey base. Like a slice of honey-drenched baklava blended into ice cream!

name: Birthday Cake
description: What’s better than birthday cake with ice cream? Birthday cake IN ice cream! Bites of house-made cake throughout pink vanilla ice cream, complete with naturally coloured sprinkles. Happy birthday to us!

name: Blackberry Coriander
description: Organic coriander (from Gathering Place Trading) brings light citrus and nutty notes to the base, while BC Blackberries (from Mandair Farms) add a fresh fruity pop. Swirled together, these flavours compliment each other to create wonderfully bright ice cream perfect for those who love fruit and citrus.

name: Butter Pecan
description: Whiskey Hazelnut’s cousin! Pecan pieces are roasted with butter and salt, and added to our ice cream base with organic vanilla. Comfort in a scoop!

name: Cannoli
description: The classic Italian pastry made into a delectable ice cream! Ricotta and cream cheese are combined in the base to achieve the right cheesy flavour, with orange zest adding a pop of brightness to balance. Mini chocolate chips and pieces of crunchy (gluten free!) cannoli shell are sprinkled throughout for lovely bites of texture.

name: Cardamom
description: Our organic cardamom comes to us from our friends at the Gathering Place, a family run business on Cortes Island.

name: Carrot Cake
description: House-made spiced carrot cake and cream cheese fudge generously sprinkled through a lightly spiced ice cream, creating a classic dessert in ice cream form. Featuring spices from Gathering Place Trading and Carrots from Discovery Organics.

name: Carrot Cake Sammie
description: Our carrot cake ice cream in sammie form: lightly spiced ice cream is sprinkled with loads of soft carrot cake chunks and rich cream cheese fudge. A layer of caramel seals our spiced cake around this decadent treat!

name: Chocolate
description: Smooth, creamy, and oh-so-chocolatey! This ice cream is a lovely balance between our Milk Chocolate and Serious Chocolate flavours, and is sure to satisfy any chocolate-lover.

name: Cinnamon Bun
description: Get ready for a delightful treat with our cinnamon bun ice cream. We’ve taken freshly baked cinnamon buns, crafted in-house, and blended them into our creamy ice cream base, creating a delightful light bread texture that melts in your mouth. Each scoop is swirled with a rich, gooey cinnamon sauce that brings the sweet, sugary goodness of a freshly baked cinnamon bun right to your cone. This harmonious fusion of flavours and textures promises to transport you to a cozy bakery with every delectable spoonful.

name: Classic Sammie
description: Our take on a classic ice cream sandwich. Tahitian vanilla ice cream is sandwiched between chocolate cake and finished with a thin layer of fudge sauce. This flavour never goes out of style!

name: Coffee
description: Made with organic, fair-trade coffee from Mount Hagen, this ice cream tastes just like a creamy iced coffee! The perfect balance of rich coffee and sweet cream, this flavour is sure to satisfy any coffee-lover.

name: Coffee Crisp
description: An Earnest take on the classic Canadian Coffee Crisp chocolate bar! A generous amount of chocolate-coated feuilletine (a french confection of thin crisp crepe) is sprinkled into our mocha ice cream base. Creamy, crunchy, chocolatey and mocha – all in one perfect scoop!

name: Coffee Toffee Sammie
description: Rich coffee ice cream is speckled with crisp espresso chocolate flakes and melty bites of toffee. Layered with fudge on soft chocolate cake, this sammie is a delectable treat with a fun mix of textures.

name: Cookies + Cream
description: Organic Chocolate Vanilla Cream Sandwich Cookies, featuring a darker chocolate flavour profile with a crisp cookie crunch. It’s all about the cookies, like a spoonful of childhood!

name: Cream Cheese
description: This ice cream is like a New York style cheesecake – smooth, creamy, and just the right amount of tartness balanced in our sweet cream base.

name: Field Berry Cheesecake
description: Why choose one berry when you can have many! A blend of local field berries (raspberry, strawberry, blackberry, blueberry & haskap) mixed into our ice cream base for a vibrant colour and flavour mixed with house-made cheesecake pieces. Combined they make the perfect mix of fruity and rich cheesy flavour awaits in every bite!

name: Fresh Lemon
description: “One of the favourites in the warmer months, it’s a refreshing and light flavour. We reduce down lemon juice and lemon zest from our friends at Chasers Juice and then add some lemon oil to really boost the flavour. This is simply mixed in with our ice cream base for an almost yoghurt- like flavour!”

name: Irish Cream
description: Your favourite Irish cream liqueur in frozen form. It’s creamy, slightly boozy, with a hint of chocolate and coffee.

name: Lemon Poppy Seed
description: A lighter, creamier frozen version of the muffin. Bright lemon ice cream speckled with dutch blue poppy seeds resulting in a beautiful, zesty treat.

name: Lemon Tart
description: This flavour originated as a sundae, but it was so scrumptious that we had to make it into an ice cream! Buttery, flaky pie crust pieces and a tangy lemon curd swirl in vanilla ice cream make for a balance of sweet, tart, creamy, and crispy in each bite.

name: London Fog
description: Made with Assam and Darjeeling black tea, bergamot and vanilla, this ice cream flavour is based on the popular drink which was invented in Vancouver!

name: Matcha Green Tea
description: Our matcha green tea powder is supplied by Aiya and grown in Nishio, a historic tea cultivation region in Japan, from a family owned and operated farm for the last 125 years. It’s a shade-grown matcha, giving it light colour and caramel notes. Aiya are dedicated to giving back to the world through helping with the reforestation of mangrove and mahogany forests in Southeast Asia. We simply blend the matcha powder straight into our ice cream base!

name: Milk & Cookies Sammie
description: House-made chocolate chip cookie chunks are generously sprinkled throughout a light milky base, along with mini chocolate chips for a bit of chocolatey crunch. Chunks of cookie are also spread on top of the sammie with a thin layer of fudge.

name: Mint Chip
description: The classic mint chocolate ice cream made with lots of house made dark chocolate chips! Like peppermint patty but better. No artificial food colouring is added so it’s white, not green. Fresh and minty, with the added crunch from the dark chocolate flakes.

name: Mint Cookie Crunch Sammie
description: Fresh mint, crunchy cookies, and rich chocolate combined into one delectable sammie! Sweet minty cookie base is swirled with pieces of our creme cookies and chunks of peppermint bark, all sealed together with a layer of fudge between soft chocolate cake.

name: Oatmeal Brown Sugar
description: Ice cream for breakfast – we think so! Simple comforting flavour made with lots of oats and brown sugar, which are cold-steeped in our ice cream base so they soften. Halfway between a bowl of cereal and a cookie, but in the form of ice cream. Friendly and comforting!

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip
description: Natural peanut butter and house-made milk chocolate flakes give this decadent flavour the perfect blend of salty richness and smooth sweet chocolate chips, it hits all the spots!

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Sammie
description: Natural peanut butter and house-made milk chocolate flakes, sandwiched together with a layer of sweet fudge on a chocolate cake – this sammie is the perfect blend of salty richness and smooth sweet chocolate, it hits all the spots!

name: Pistachio
description: A classic flavour, finally at Earnest! Pistachio is the ultimate smooth, creamy, and nutty flavour. Pistachio butter is coming to us from our friends at Premier Nuts.

name: Raspberry
description: Locally sourced raspberries harvested in the peak of summer from our friends at family-run Mandair Farms bring this flavour to life. Its bright, tart and fresh – perfect for summer days.

name: Salted Caramel
description: A classic for good reason. We’ve been making this one since day one and it remains a favourite still. Deeply caramelized sugar mixed with cream and salt from Vancouver Island Sea Salt Co. Its rich, creamly and buttery and the perfect balance of salty and sweet.

name: Salted Chocolate Rye Cookie
description: This is an Earnest cult favourite! Featuring bite sized fudgy, chocolate rye cookies in a light, salted chocolate ice cream. This flavour is inspired by the rye cookie from our neighbours on Fraser St (Batard Bakery). If you’re a chocolate lover then you must try this sensational flavour.

name: Sour Cherry Goat Cheese
description: This complex flavour is tart and rich – with an elevated fro-yo tanginess. Highlighting Okanagan cherries (sourced through Pacific Coast Fruit) and goat cheese from Hewitt’s, a Canadian farmer-owned company.

name: Sour Cherry Goat Cheese Sammie
description: Since we missed it as a seasonal, this cult classic is back as a sammie, but with a twist! Goat cheese ice cream is swirled with sour cherry compote to create a wonderfully cheesy and fruity flavour profile. Topped with a tart cherry jam that has a hint of almond extract added to boost that cherry flavour, plus a layer of goat cheese-vanilla cake crumble to complete this cheesy sammie. It’s the perfect bright treat for these hot summer days!

name: Strawberry
description: Local strawberries from Mandair Farms are picked at the peak of the season and frozen to preserve their vibrant fruitiness to enjoy in winter. We add a touch of white balsamic to enhance and balance the natural sweetness of the strawberries. A must try for fans of strawberry ice cream!

name: Tahitian Vanilla
description: This flavour has been a core since day one. Our pure vanilla extract is sourced from premium slow-grown, sun-cured vanilla beans of the “Tahitian” variety. The flavour from the beans is cold-extracted to preserve its complex bouquet. These vanilla beans are brighter and more floral than the rounder, woodsier Madagascar variety.

name: Toasted Marshmallow
description: This flavour honours a classic summer time tradition with major campfire vibes! Roasted house-made marshmallows are blended into our ice cream base. Tastes and melts in your mouth just like a real toasted marshmallow!

name: Vegan Apple Crisp
description: BC Honeycrisp apples roasted with brown sugar and whiskey for a lovely caramelized flavour. Swirled into a lightly spiced oat-coconut base, along with generous handfuls of oat crisp crumble. Like a warm apple crisp a la mode!

name: Vegan Black Forest
description: Light coconut ice cream is sprinkled with dark chocolate flakes and generous handfuls of rich, gluten-friendly chocolate cake. Bright cherry compote is swirled throughout for a pop of bright fruitiness. Each bite is a symphony of decadent textures and flavours – everything you want from a black forest cake!

name: Vegan Blueberries & Cream
description: The perfect mix of light vanilla and bright berry flavours, this new flavour is like a bowl of fresh blueberries topped with whipped cream! Our vanilla oat-coconut base is brightened with a splash of lemon juice and swirled with house-made blueberry compote from all Canadian berries.

name: Vegan Caramel Apple Crisp Sammie
description: Sweet and crispy, this sammie is a delightful mix of apple-y brightness and rich caramel flavours. Our lightly spiced apple crisp ice cream has bits of toffee speckled throughout for a pop of caramely goodness in every bite! All sandwiched between vanilla-apple cake with a layer of apple-caramel to seal it together.

name: Vegan Chocolate
description: A vegan staple we have been running since day one! Surprisingly creamy and rich, the subtle bitterness of dark chocolate and cocoa powder add depth to the creaminess of our coconut milk base.

name: Vegan Chocolate Cupcake
description: Light chocolate ice cream dotted with pieces of gluten-free chocolate cake and naturally coloured sprinkles. Sweet chocolate frosting ripple completes this cupcake inspired flavour, resulting in a rich, chocolaty treat in celebration of Earnest’s birthday!

name: Vegan Chocolate Orange Sammie
description: Creamy chocolate-orange ice cream is swirled with ribbons of orange jelly. Sandwiched with a layer of orange-fudge and chocolate cake, this sammie tastes just like a Terry’s Chocolate Orange!

name: Vegan Coconut Brownie Sammie
description: Light chocolate ice cream is speckled with toasted coconut flakes and topped with a layer of fudge and bites of fudgey brownie. The resulting sammie is a delightful mix of chocolate and coconut flavours and textures!

name: Vegan Cookie Butter Sammie
description: House-made speculoos cookies are combined in a variety of ways into this delectable ice cream! Rich cookie butter is swirled throughout a lightly spiced base and topped with a speculoos cookie crumble for a lovely bite of added texture.

name: Vegan Cookies + Cream
description: A vegan twist on a childhood favourite that is brimming with chunks of cookies in a creamy vanilla base. Fun fact, we make this flavour with the exact same organic chocolate sandwich cookies we use in our dairy cookies and cream!

name: Vegan Fudgey Chocolate Cookie Sammie
description: The ultimate chocolate decadence sammie! Chocolate ice cream is sprinkled with chocolate chips and chocolate sandwich cookie pieces, topped with a thick layer of fudge and sandwiched with soft chocolate cake. Rich and oh-so-chocolatey!

name: Vegan Key Lime Pie
description: Our take on key lime pie in vegan ice cream form! A tart lime-coconut ice cream base with a house-made graham crumble. The sweet crumble offsets the tartness of the base, creating a nicely balanced bite with a scrumptious texture!

name: Vegan Mango
description: We blend mango puree into our classic vegan base, resulting in a beautifully vibrant and fruity treat! Mango puree is sourced from Ponthier.

name: Vegan Mocha Brownie Sammie
description: House-made, cakey brownie chunks mixed into mocha ice cream, alongside delightfully crunchy chocolate sprinkles. Surrounded by soft chocolate cake and a layer of mocha fudge, this rich and decadent sammie is a must try for mocha fans.

name: Vegan Nanaimo Bar
description: This is the classic BC dessert bar in ice cream form! Dark chocolate chips and nanaimo bar crumble in our creamy coconut-cashew “custard” base.

name: Vegan Peaches & Cream
description: Like a roasted peach topped with vanilla ice cream and a sprinkle of cinnamon! Our oat-coconut base with an added hint of cinnamon is swirled with a bright, roasted peach compote. Fresh peaches are sourced from Jobst-Hof Orchard, a family operated orchard in the beautiful Okanagan Valley.

name: Vegan Raspberry
description: One of our original vegan flavours. Local raspberries from Mandair Farms pureed and blended into our signature vegan coconut base – it’s bright, tart, refreshing and looks as good as it tastes.

name: Vegan S’mores
description: The campfire staple brought to life as a vegan ice cream! House-made cookies are blended into the base to mimic the flavour of a graham cracker, as well as a sprinkle of graham crumble for texture. Dandies vegan marshmallows are toasted and folded in along with a rich fudgey swirl, supplying caramelly notes to round out that toasty s’mores flavour.

name: Vegan Strawberry Chocolate Sprinkle Sammie
description: Bright strawberry ice cream is speckled with deliciously chocolatey sprinkles. Sandwiched with a layer of strawberry jam on soft chocolate cake, this fruity-chocolatey treat is perfectly balanced and scrumptious!

name: Vegan Strawberry Elderflower Ripple
description: Local, organic elderflowers from Elderberry Grove Farm are steeped into our classic oat-coconut base. Swirled with fresh strawberry sauce, this flavour is bright and fruity with a delicate floral background – perfectly refreshing for these hot summer days!

name: Vegan Strawberry Rhubarb Ripple
description: This delightful vegan flavour is perfect for reminiscing the summer sun. Local strawberries and rhubarb create our flavoursome and vibrant compote, swirled throughout our creamy vanilla ice cream.

name: Vegan Toasted Coconut
description: The vegan version of our beloved toasted coconut ice cream. Desiccated coconut is toasted in house, supplying a depth of nutty flavour. Coconut extract is added to pack in those wonderful tropical tasting notes. Creamy coconut bliss!

name: Vegan Turtles Sammie
description: Our light chocolate vegan base has walnut praline blended into it to create a nutty background flavour. Sweet toffee bits, dark chocolate chips, and roasted, salted nuts are generously sprinkled throughout for pops of crunch and caramelly goodness. All sealed together with a layer of sweet fudge on soft chocolate cake, this sammie is a delectable combination of sweet, salty, nutty, and crunchy – just like a classic turtles candy!

name: Whiskey Hazelnut
description: An Earnest Ice Cream original, made from day one and remains a favourite and top-seller. Roasted, salted BC hazelnuts in Whiskey ice cream base. A smooth, boozy flavour with a buttery crunch.
